title: ISO 15 deep-groove ball bearing seats
summary: Press and clearance seats, shoulders and retaining lips for 608, 625, 6001 and 6002 radial bearings.

source.name: ISO 15 (radial bearings — boundary dimensions)
source.licence: Standard document copyrighted; boundary dimensions used here are published facts from the standard's public dimension tables. Implementation is original.
source.notes: 608-2RS shares the 608 boundary (8x22x7) with contact seals — one entry serves both.

assertions.name: seat spacing on mid-plane is 60 mm
mid-plane section area (two seat bores cut)

print_notes: Print seats with the bearing axis vertical, bore up, 0.2 mm layers, 4 walls. A snug press seat may need 0.05–0.1 mm added for printers that squish; verify with the gauge plate before committing a housing.
